description: Use when the user wants to watch a TV channel or live news (e.g. 'play BBC News', '凤凰卫视直播', 'Japanese news live'). Finds free, official 24/7 live channels (news, business, kids, music, religious and more; Simplified/Traditional Chinese names both work) with country, language, whether the stream plays worldwide and current viewers. In clients that support MCP Apps the best match starts playing right away in GlobeNow.tv's player; it can move to picture-in-picture and keep playing while the user chats.

category.description: news, business, kids, music, religious, entertainment, sports, documentary…

country.description: Country name or ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, e.g. 'Japan' or 'JP'.

language.description: Language for titles and links: en (default), zh, zh-hant, ja, ko (zh-CN, zh-TW, ja-JP… also accepted)

query.description: Channel name or keywords, e.g. 'BBC', 'Al Jazeera', 'NHK', 'Bloomberg'.

worldwide_only.description: Only channels that play in every country.

name: find_live_tv
title: Play a live TV channel
